lines.text: Did you know? Graph is Greek for write or draw.
Photograph: light plus write or draw.
Paragraph: beside plus write or draw.
Quick quiz! Which means beside plus write or draw?
Paragraph! Beside plus write or draw.

words.ex: She took a photograph of the old bridge.

words.mean: a mark written beside the text
words.ex: Each paragraph should have one main idea.
